Per-graph benchmark_model rows (latency + delegate coverage on random inputs; every gather index is clamped in-graph so the tool cannot fault); no on-device functional run exists — functional parity is Mac-only on the same files (FINDINGS §8). `artifact` is the file name the bench driver used on the phone; slow_drq8_p256.tflite = the two-signature dynamic-int8 slow AR shipped as slow_ar_int8.tflite (built_from slow/slow_drq8_c2048_p256.tflite); the mapping to the published file is build_manifest.json built_from + FINDINGS ('S26 clean legs ... 2-signature slow graphs = the shipped files', §6 'shipped files') and the card's Performance table, which quotes these legs; the device copy's bytes were not digested in the log, so artifact_sha256 is absent (#167(e) shape). One record per signature (#167(c)): decode (one frame) and prefill_256 (one 256-position chunk). No GPU row for this file: the GPU leg of the session ran the three-signature predecessor slow_drq8_v3.tflite (s26_ar_bench.log lines 39-52: 56/1456 nodes on LITERT_CL after 'GATHER_ND: Operation is not supported', 20.49 ms avg, 1580/1682 MB), which is not the published graph — its op fact is staged for the matrix, not recorded here. The card's memory note: the multi-signature file packs its weights once per signature (init 1077 MB for this 552 MB file; the three-signature build 1441 MB, s26_ar_bench.log lines 15-38). Dates: the legs carry no per-run stamp; 2026-09-28 is the session date (FINDINGS/NOTES header, the g2 full log's own epoch 1790547879 = 2026-09-28 07:24 JST, out/ mtimes 06:59-07:27 JST, all before the 09:12 JST Hub upload). Hand-built from the logs (build script in the session scratchpad); model-level facts only, no op row derives from this record (the op-level lines are staged separately for the matrix).
